newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Port conditions update - S.Korea - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - S.Korea - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

Busan, March 31 - Berth congestion situation/berthing delays - Busan - 165 vessels in port, 67 at berth and 98 at anchorage. Usually two to three days delay due to berth congestion. Ulsan - 74 vessels in port, 36 at berth and 38 at anchorage. Usually one to two days delay due to berth congestion. Pohang - 40 vessels in port, 36 at berth and four at anchorage. Usually one day's delay due to berth congestion. Inchon 69 vessels in port, 49 at berth and 20 at anchorage. Usually one to two days delay due berth congestion.
